title: When Bulldozers Loom: Informal Property Rights and Marketing Practice Innovation Among Emerging Market Microentrepreneurs
authors: Magda Hassan; Jaideep C Prabhu; Rajesh K. Chandy; Om Narasimhan
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Cross-sectional survey of Cairo micro-entrepreneurs: OLS and IV (ivreg2) of marketing-practice innovation indices on informal store leasing (store_rent), instrumented with parents born in Cairo (migr_parentborn_incai_yn) and birth after 1978, with psychological, demographic and business controls.
design_notes: WBL_dofile_final (paper).do: globals xlist = store_rent, zlist = migr_parentborn_incai_yn; reg and ivreg2 of differ_final20, index_custserv16, index_price7_miss, index_promoall6, index_place_gps3, and performance outcomes (walk-ins, revenue, profit). One observation per entrepreneur; no time dimension.
data_files_note: Survey data shipped (Stata .dta); no statement of masking.
data_provenance_note: Authors' survey data as used in the do-file.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
